prompt_change: Do not include comments or reasoning. Keep the solution concise and complete.
fence_format: unchanged: one closed python code block
selection_rule: Use concise prompt iff correct_candidates >= 137 AND token_cap_hits < 78 on the fixed 32-problem training probe; otherwise retain original prompt. Mixed groups are reported, not used to drop tasks. No development result is used to select the prompt.

training.start: original pinned quantized base, not prior smoke adapter

development_protocol: Recompute greedy original-model baseline using selected prompt; compare greedy answers on same 67 fixed problems after each 10 updates. Select only strict development improvements. Confirmation remains untouched.
